hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.md) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) [ -f tsconfig.json ] && { out=$(npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20); [ -n "$out" ] && { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; };; esac; exit 0

w=''; for p in 8000 8002 8200 5373; do lsof -ti:$p >/dev/null 2>&1 && w="$w $p"; done; [ -n "$w" ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"Ports still held:%s - kill only processes YOU started this session"}' "$w"; exit 0
